sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ravi Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Upendra Kumar Pushkar Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant and learned A.G.A. for the State are present.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.488 of 2022,
under Sections 452, 376/384, 506 IPC, police station Ghandhi Park, District Aligarh with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant-accused that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

The first information report was lodged by the prosecutrix alleging that applicant-accused used to visit her home and that on 18.06.2022, while her parents were not present, the applicant-accused came at her home and committed rape upon her by saying that he would marry her and later on he told that he has prepared her obscene video and demanded an amount of rupees three lakhs from prosecutrix.

Learned counsel submitted that victim F Lalit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185241063/
1 is a mature lady, about about 23-24 years, and her allegations, are thoroughly false.

sentences.text: After the alleged incident, no complaint was made.
In her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., victim has inter-alia stated that earlier she wanted to marry with applicant-accused.
Further, in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., victim has stated that applicant-accused has established physical relations with her on pretext of marriage.
She has also stated that she has seen the alleged video prepared by the applicant-accused but in that video her face is not visible.
During investigation, no video or photographs of victim has been seized by the police from applicant-accused or from any other person.

Referring to the facts of the matter, it was submitted that all attending facts and circumstances of the case show that victim has been a consenting party and that she has lodged the first information report of this case with mala fide intention, making false and baseless allegations.

Lastly, it has been submitted that the applicant-accused is languishing in jail since 17.09.2022,
having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant-accused is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
Learned counsel for the informant and learned A.G.A. have opposed the prayer for bail and argued that there are allegations of rape against applicant-accused.

It was submitted that the prosecutrix has clearly stated that after committing rape upon her, applicant-accused has also prepared an obscene video of her and that he has demanded an amount of rupees three lakhs from her to delete/return the said video.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant-accused Lalit Kumar involved in aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
1. The applicant-accused shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2. The applicant-accused shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
3. The applicant-accused shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4.
The applicant-accused shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

5. The applicant-accused shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
